model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

steps.start: the point of intersection of the midline of Dutch Creek and the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way
steps.quote: Commencing in the vicinity of Fairmont at the point of intersection of the midline of Dutch Creek and the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way

steps.until: the point of intersection with the south boundary of S.L. 10, D.L. 344, Kootenay Land District
steps.quote: thence in a general southerly direction along the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way to the point of intersection with the south boundary of S.L. 10, D.L. 344, Kootenay Land District

steps.until: the southeast corner of S.L.9
steps.quote: thence in a general easterly direction along the southerly boundaries of S.L. 10 and S.L. 9 to the southeast corner of S.L.9

steps.until: the northeast corner of S.L.19
steps.quote: thence southerly in a straight line to the northeast corner of S.L.19

steps.until: the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way
steps.quote: thence westerly along the northerly boundary of S.L.19 to the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way

steps.until: the southerly boundary of S.L.19
steps.quote: thence southerly along the easterly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way to the southerly boundary of S.L.19

steps.until: the natural boundary of Columbia Lake on the westerly shore thereof
steps.quote: thence easterly along the southerly boundary of S.L.19 and a prolongation thereof to the natural boundary of Columbia Lake on the westerly shore thereof

steps.until: the point of intersection with an easterly prolongation of the north boundary of S.L.19
steps.quote: thence in a general northerly direction along the natural boundary of Columbia Lake on the westerly shore thereof to the point of intersection with an easterly prolongation of the north boundary of S.L.19

steps.until: the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Columbia Lake on the easterly shore thereof at its intersection with the natural boundary of Warspite Creek on the right bank thereof
steps.quote: thence easterly in a straight line to the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Columbia Lake on the easterly shore thereof at its intersection with the natural boundary of Warspite Creek on the right bank thereof

steps.side_or_bank: easterly shore of Columbia Lake; right bank of Columbia River
steps.until: the south boundary of Block P.3043
steps.quote: thence in a general northerly direction along the natural boundary of Columbia Lake on the easterly shore thereof and the natural boundary of Columbia River on the right bank thereof to the south boundary of Block P.3043

steps.until: the south boundary of S.L.36
steps.quote: thence easterly and northerly along the southerly and easterly boundaries of Block P.3043 to the south boundary of S.L.36

steps.until: the south boundary of S.L.11
steps.quote: thence easterly and northerly along the southerly and easterly boundaries of S.L.36 to the south boundary of S.L.11

steps.until: the south boundary of the Fairmont Ski Hill area
steps.quote: thence easterly and northerly along the southerly and easterly boundaries of S.L.11 and along a northerly prolongation to the south boundary of the Fairmont Ski Hill area

steps.until: the northerly boundary of S.L.126 at a point adjacent to its intersection with the midline of Cold Spring Creek
steps.quote: thence easterly, northerly and westerly along the southerly, easterly and northerly boundaries of the Fairmont Ski Hill area to the northerly boundary of S.L.126 at a point adjacent to its intersection with the midline of Cold Spring Creek

steps.until: the southeast corner of S.L.119
steps.quote: thence westerly along the northerly boundary of S.L.126 to the southeast corner of S.L.119

steps.until: the northeast corner of S.L.118
steps.quote: thence northerly and westerly along the easterly and northerly boundaries of S.L.119 to the northeast corner of S.L.118

steps.until: the natural boundary of Columbia River on the right bank thereof
steps.quote: thence westerly along the northerly boundary of S.L.118 and a prolongation thereof to the natural boundary of Columbia River on the right bank thereof

steps.until: the northerly boundary of D.L.5352
steps.quote: thence southerly along the natural boundary of Columbia River on the right bank thereof to the northerly boundary of D.L.5352

steps.until: the westerly boundary of Westside Road right of way
steps.quote: thence westerly along the northerly boundary of D.L.5352 and a prolongation thereof to the westerly boundary of Westside Road right of way

steps.until: the southerly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way
steps.quote: thence southerly along the westerly boundary of Westside Road right of way and a prolongation thereof to the southerly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way

steps.until: the point of commencement
steps.quote: thence westerly along the southerly boundary of Highway 93/95 right of way to the point of commencement
